people.name: Eglath-shelishiyah
people.line: Moabite city; its destruction prophesied by Isaiah and Jeremiah

people.name: Elealeh
people.line: Moabite city assigned to Reuben; later prophecies of destruction

people.name: Heshbon
people.line: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben

people.name: Horonaim
people.line: A Moabite city mentioned in prophecies of judgment

people.name: Jahaz
people.line: A town in Moab, site of Israelite victories

people.name: Nimrim
people.line: A place in Moab known for its waters

people.name: Zoar
people.line: A city near Sodom, spared from destruction

translations.web: From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz they have uttered their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for the waters of Nimrim will also become desolate.
translations.bsb: There is a cry from Heshbon to Elealeh; they raise their voices to Jahaz, from Zoar to Horonaim and Eglath-shelishiyah; for even the waters of Nimrim have dried up.
translations.kjv: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, and even unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.
translations.asv: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, even unto Jahaz have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, to Eglath-shelishiyah: for the waters of Nimrim also shall become desolate.
